input: Get the car's brakes inspected this month

gold.taskTitle: Get Car Brakes Inspected This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to have their car's brakes professionally inspected within the current month.

questions.title: What specific symptoms or concerns prompted this inspection?
questions.description: Understand whether there are warning signs like squeaking, grinding, or reduced stopping power, or if this is routine maintenance.

questions.title: What is the make, model, and year of the car?
questions.description: Identify the vehicle so the right service center and brake specifications can be targeted.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred mechanic or dealership already?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing trusted service provider or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target date within the month?
questions.description: Pinpoint a specific date or window so urgency and scheduling can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: Is the car currently safe and drivable to a shop?
questions.description: Assess whether the car can be driven in or needs to be towed, which affects logistics.

questions.title: What is your budget for the inspection and potential repairs?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints in case the inspection reveals brake work that needs to be done immediately.

questions.title: Will you need a loaner car or ride during the service?
questions.description: Determine if transportation arrangements need to be factored into the plan while the car is being serviced.
